Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Most earlier cards printed with effects usable "during a political action"
now have errata (or most recent printings) changing their texts to "during
the referendum of a political action" (eg Mausoleum, Venice; Oxford
University, England). But the new Kholo cards say they are playable simply
"during a political action". Does that mean that you can play a Kholo card
to gain the title as soon as a political action begins (ie before the
referendum part, even if it's going to be blocked)?

Josh

the swiftest are kholo

Messages.Author: flan
Messages.Body:


We had an interesting situation where the Guruhi called a political
action to get it out of his hand. His prey jumped on it with a Vox
Domini (or whatever the vote-fails one is), and the question was the
subtly different, if there is a successful action but there's no
referundum. Does there actually have to be a vote, or does any kind of
card that gets rid of the referendum mean there's no window.

We decided it was fine, so Guruhi went from having 0 votes against to
having 6 against. Fun times. Fun card.
